use: Style evidence only; never copy phrases, facts, numbers or identity.
method: Roster weights normalized over available eligible donors; equal mass per donor post; sentence mass equal within post. UTC cadence over observed scrape interval. Signature lift is weighted cluster document frequency divided by unweighted eligible all-donor document frequency (3-word EN / 4-character ZH n-grams, present in at least 2 cluster posts).

qualitative.variation_notes: Length ranges from one-line reactions and single-data-point posts to multi-paragraph earnings or policy breakdowns. Median sentence length is about 32 characters, with a wide interquartile spread. Register moves from analyst-like structured lists to colloquial, sarcastic or lifestyle-adjacent asides. Some donors break posts into very short stacked lines, one clause per line, while others write dense paragraphs. Claim-led openings dominate, but question, quote, number-led and data-relay hooks all appear. About 40% of posts attach media. Emoji use is light and concentrated in short, ironic posts.
qualitative.judgment_style: Mostly assertive, with views stated as the author's own call, but often conditioned on specific upcoming data, meetings or price levels through explicit if/then framing. Probabilistic language and admissions of uncertainty appear sometimes, usually as a brief aside rather than extended hedging. Data mainly supports a pre-stated stance: figures are lined up to justify the verdict rather than explored neutrally. Forecasts are sometimes tied to the author's own positioning, and earlier calls are cited as a track record.

compliance_removed: Shares the author's own trades, cash level or allocation preference to ground the view
